full_page.content:
1950, August 10
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Sclanus Carey, O. F.M. Cap.
Saint Felix Capuchin Friary Hungtington Indiana August 10th , 1950
Blessed be God in all His designs.
God bless you Miss Muriel.
Many thanks for your kind favor of yesterday - Glad things are coming on favorably. Hope the your tiny niece shakes off that whooping, etc.
Keep well yourself but shake off some of that anxiety about your and others' health. Thank God I am feeling fine again. Hope you can shortly say the same. Before laying your letter aside and then forgetting I tho't I'd just drop you a card - then spoild it. -
Fr. Solanus
